market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: The 2028 election is distant and highly uncertain. Marco Rubio faces a crowded, undefined Republican primary field and an unknown general election environment. The market's 14.2% implied probability appears too high for any single individual this far out.
evidence_points: Historical early frontrunners often fail to secure nomination
Polling 3+ years out has virtually no predictive power for presidential winners
Numerous ambitious Republicans (DeSantis, Haley, etc.) could enter the race
